'''Pindy Streeto''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] who was a member of the [[Rancor Riders]], a criminal gang that operated on [[Tolea Biqua]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. [[Zelice Sturm]] paid her to help her monitor the gang's interactions with the [[Heroes of Cularin]] and afterwards, she paid for Streeto to leave the [[Cularin system/Legends|Cularin system]]. Sturm later assumed Streeto's identity, to try and confuse the heroes.
